selected_headlines: Updated state review finds St. Lucie County glioblastoma cases in line with expectations
source_headlines: Still no cancer cluster? Florida updates Treasure Coast brain cancer review - cw34.com
novel_facts: The updated review excludes oligodendroglioma classification codes 9450 and 9451, which were included in the 2019 analysis, because the current glioblastoma definition no longer includes them.
The report includes 2014–2023 analyses for ZIP codes 34952, 34983 and 34982, none showing a statistically significant excess.
